entities.name: Kari Zev
entities.description: A human pirate from Avishkar, captain of the skyship Dragon's Smile, working with the Renegades.

entities.name: Ragavan
entities.description: Kari's monkey companion and First Mate.

entities.name: Baral
entities.description: Former Consulate officer rescued by Kari Zev.

entities.name: Sun Chaser
entities.description: Pirate ship on which Kari first served.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Invasion during which Baral's prison was breached.

events.summary: Kari runs away from Ghirapur at thirteen after being expelled from her apprenticeship.
events.quote: Kari packed up her things and ran away from home at age thirteen

events.summary: Kari meets the stowaway monkey Ragavan aboard the Sun Chaser.
events.quote: where she met the monkey Ragavan

events.summary: Kari saves Baral from Phyrexian attackers and offers him a place in her crew or the void.
events.quote: he was unexpectedly saved by Kari Zev

events.summary: Kari sponsors the Keelhaulers at the Ghirapur Grand Prix.
